title: Esquire awards and closing remarks
summary: He holds three Esquire silver awards in the years Benny Goodman won gold, and says he is still working for more.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Being honored: NEA Jazz Masters and other awards

blocks.x: Did you mention the Esquire awards?
I got -- Well, I have three Esquire awards when they were giving them out.
Silver. I got the silver one. Benny Goodman got the gold. And that was for three years straight. So that was nice, too.
So I can't complain and I enjoyed every bit of it. I'm trying to get some more and I'm working at it, and see how long I can last.
You have a long ways to go, my love.
